chosen_theta_reason: θ = 0.1 minimises mean Γ across the 5-seed sweep at p=0.5, balancing recall (in-topic biased memories retained) against precision (off-topic biased memories filtered). The choice is refuted if any other value in {0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3} gives a strictly lower Γ on the full DeepSeek dose-response curve.
